subject.title: fix(anthropic): handle max_turns stop reason and surface retry-limit details to users

question: Should Anthropic `max_turns` remain public `length` with raw `provider_stop_reason` diagnostics, rather than becoming an `error` or a new public stop reason?
rationale: The code can implement several terminal-state shapes, but the choice affects runner/session finalization and the public `StopReason` contract, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept `length` Plus Raw Diagnostics
options.body: Land this approach after preserving the side-effect warning so existing `length` semantics stay stable while Anthropic-specific context remains available in diagnostics.

options.title: Treat `max_turns` As Error
options.body: Ask for a rewrite that routes `max_turns` through the error path and tests error finalization behavior.

options.title: Add A Public Stop Reason
options.body: Pause this PR for a broader contract change if downstream code should branch on a first-class `max_turns` stop reason.

recommendation.title: Accept `length` Plus Raw Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Land this approach after preserving the side-effect warning so existing `length` semantics stay stable while Anthropic-specific context remains available in diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the Anthropic transport runtime where the raw provider stop reason is normalized.
